company_notes:
Summary: Large federal archive search program — RAG style retrieval + rerank pipeline. Primary ask: on-prem, air-gapped deploy with strong KMS/HSM and audit trail. Indexing scale = ~35-70M discrete documents (mix of scanned PDFs, OCR text, intelligence reports). Latency requirement: 95th pct <150ms for vector + rerank path for short-query workflows; offline batch reindex windows nightly. Cost sensitivity: strict Opex targets; target amortized cost per user query <$0.02 — procurement will push for detailed unit economics.

Conversation highlights (shorthand):
- "We cannot ship anything that touches internet egress in production" (G-5 security lead).
- Wants end-to-end proof that KV/prefix caching works inside air-gapped env and that batching doesn't blow tail latency.
- Reranking currently done in-house (legacy SVM); interest in Redwood rerank stage if can meet determinism and auditability requirements.
- Model preference: open LLMs only; probable quantized L2 variants. They will not accept vendor-hosted models for production.

Procurement notes: heavy GFE (government furnished equipment) and STIG/SCAP checklist items. Expect 8-12 week procurement cycle after SOW sign-off. Finance has asked for cost breakdown by: indexing (storage/embedding compute), per-query infer cost (vector search + rerank), and projected support hours.

Security review status: initial security questionnaire completed; awaiting pen-test window scheduling. They require proof of SOC2-equivalent controls and an ISO27001 statement for the on-prem packaging.

POC scope suggested by AE: 1) Deploy Redwood Private pilot in their air-gapped lab (3 GPU nodes) 2) Ingest 10M doc subset, build embeddings + index, test QPS 20 — measure latency, cache hit%, cost per query 3) Evaluate Redwood reranking with labeled set of 2k queries.

Quotes / quick notes from meetings: "If you can't show a deterministic rerank reproducible offline we will keep it in-house." — Head of Search.

Sales ask: push a compact SOW template, draft KMS integration notes, and confirm procedure for offline kernel approvals and audit logs retrieval.

requirements_summary: Must-run fully offline (air-gapped) with no outbound egress. Embeddings pipeline for ~50M docs with nightly incremental indexing. Reranking as a second-stage model that can be audited and run deterministically; ability to pin model versions and store model weights within customer HSM-protected storage. Latency SLO: 95th <150ms for vector+rerank at target QPS 30. Cost per query target <$0.02 (amortized) including storage and compute. Ops needs: on-call runbook, patch window schedule (monthly), and secure audit-log export (syslog/SIEM compatible).
summary_one_liner: Government archive search — procurement-heavy, air-gapped on-prem RAG with embeddings + deterministic rerank; POC requested for scale/latency/cost validation
